title: Route Rebuild Additions for Late Changes to Mobile In-Home Collection Visits
content:
## Dispatch memo — Specimen Collection Appointments

The phlebotomist's route for a day is already out once that day has begun, and the long routes of service zone 3 are planned a day ahead. A late change to a home visit therefore carries a route rebuild addition set by the service zone on the visit record and the day the change is recorded, counted in calendar days from today to the current appointment date.

**Clause.** A visit in service zone 3 moved on its appointment date adds 15.00, a visit in service zone 3 moved the day before adds 10.00, a visit in service zone 2 moved on its appointment date adds 5.00, and any other late change (a zone 2 visit moved the day before, or a zone 1 visit) adds nothing.

| Service zone | Moved on the appointment date | Moved the day before |
|---|---|---|
| Service zone 3 | 15.00 | 10.00 |
| Service zone 2 | 5.00 | Nothing |
| Service zone 1 | Nothing | Nothing |

**Readings (hypothetical Mobile In-Home Collection Visits).** Zone 3, change recorded the day before: 10.00. Zone 2, change recorded on the appointment date: 5.00. Zone 1, change recorded on the appointment date: nothing.
